limitations: No chief-architect review was obtained. All four decisions are PROPOSED, not approved. The reference models in contracts/contractstest show the proposed rules are self-consistent and testable; they are not evidence about production code, which does not exist.

S3 conditional create is documented (the coordinator's source check, s3-conditional-write-source-check.md) but was not qualified against our bucket, bucket policy or CLI/SDK build. Live qualification needs an authorized disposable resource and was not attempted.

No MaxMutationStageBytes measurement exists, and no OS-enforced size limit under the staging area is designed or tested. StageMeter counts only the bytes its caller reports, so the storage proposal claims an accounting ceiling, not a hard physical bound. Decision 1 stays BLOCKED.
No schema migration was added; store/migrations.go is unchanged. Nothing under internal/hosted/service or internal/cli imports the contracts.
Mutation checks on the reference models and on ManifestV2.Validate were run by hand with throwaway scripts that are not committed. Only the resulting conformance cases are in the repo.

An earlier stray test process was stopped with a broad pkill pattern; later work killed only exact PIDs.
